blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Sunday flagged at least P241 billion in fragmented “ayudas” or assistance programs in the Senate version of the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 budget measure, calling them mere “patronage spending” that wouldn’t help revive the economy.
